content: Yihuda Kawa Minaase
Minaasey kawotiya wode iyaw laythi tammanne nam7a; I Yerusalaamen ishatammanne ichashu laythi kawotis; iya aaye sunthay Hefseebo.
Goday Isra7eele asa sinthafe gooddidi kessida asata de7uwa wogaa kaallidi, Minaasey Godaa sinthan iitaba oothis.

Iya aaway Hizqiyaasi laallida, dhoqa goyinno bessata I zaaridi keexis; Isra7eele kawoy Akaabi oothidaysada, Ba7aale xoossaas yarsho bessatanne Asheera xoosse misileta medhis. Qassi salo xoolintota ubbaa goyinnis; entana haggaazis.
Goday, “Taani ta sunthaa Yerusalaamen xeegisana” yaagidi odida Xoossa keethan hara xoossatas yarsho bessata giigisis.
Xoossa keethan de7iya nam7u dabaabatan salo xoolintota ubbaas yarsho bessata giigisis.
Ba na7aa tama giddora aathis. I ba huuphen bitanchonne murunniya asi gididi, marotanne moytilleta zore oychis. Godaa sinthan daro iitabaa oothidi, iya hanqethis.

Masetidi keyida Asheera xoosse misiliya ehidi, Xoossa keetha giddon essis. He Xoossa keethay, Goday Dawitanne iya na7aa Solomone, “Isra7eele zare ubbaa giddofe taani doorida ha Xoossa keethan Yerusalaamen taani ta sunthaa merinaw xeegisana.
Isra7eele asa taani kiitida kiita ubbaanne ta aylley Musey entaw immida higgiya ubba naagidi oothiko, taani enta mayzatas immida biittafe enta denthada dhaysike” yaagida Xoossa keetha.
Shin asay si7onnan ixis; Goday Isra7eele asaa sinthafe dhaysida hara kawotethatape aadhidi iita oothana mela Minaasey enta balethis.
Goday ba aylle gidida nabeta baggara haysada yaagis;
“Yihuda kawoy Minaasey ha tuna oosuwa oothis; baape kase de7ida Amoore asa ubbaa nagaraape aadhiya iita nagara oothis. Yihuda asa ba medhida eeqa misiliya goyinnisidi, nagara oosisis.
Goday, Isra7eele Xoossay haysada yaagees; ‘Heko, si7iya asa ubbaa haythas iitiya dhayo Yerusalaame bollanne Yihuda bolla ehana hanayis.

Samaare bolla yeggida wadha wodoruwa, Yerusalaame bolla yeggana; Akaaba soo asaa bolla yeddida tumbiya, Yerusalaame bolla yeddana. Issi asi kere meeccidi gufanthidi meliseysada, taani Yerusalaame quchada gufanthana.
Ta asaape attidaysata taani yegga aggana; taani enta enta morketa kushen aathada immana. Enta morketi ubbay enta oykananne bonqana.
Enta mayzati Gibxefe keyoosope hachi gakanaw, enti ta sinthan iitabaa oothida gishonne tana hanqethida gisho, taani haysa oothana’ ” yaagis.
Minaasey Yihuda asaa, Godaa sinthan nagara oosisidaysa bolla gujidi, xillo asaa wodhis; Yerusalaame gaxape gaxa gakanaw, suuthan kunthis.
Minaasey hanida harabay, I oothidabay, I oothida nagaray Yihuda Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetis.
Minaasey hayqidi, ba mayzatan gahetis; ba gadhuwa matan de7iya Oza gaden moogetis; iya bessan iya na7ay Amooni kawotis.
Yihuda Kawa Amoone
Amooni kawotiya wode, iyaw laythi laatamanne nam7a; I Yerusalaamen nam7u laythi kawotis. Iya aaye sunthay Masulaamo; iya Yooxiba addiya Haruse na7a.
Iya aaway, Minaasey oothidaysada, Amooneyka Godaa sinthan iitabaa oothis.
I ba aaway hemetida ogiyan hemetis; ba aaway oothida eeqatas ika oothis; enta goyinnis.
Godaa, ba mayzata Xoossaa aggis; Godaa ogiyan I hemetibeenna.
Amoone shuumati iya bolla maqetidi, kawo gadhon iya wodhidosona.
Hessafe guye, Yihuda asay Kawa Amoone bolla maqetida ubbata wodhidosona. Amoone bessan iya na7aa Iyosyaasa kawothidosona.
Amooni hanida harabaynne I oothidaba ubbay Yihuda Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetis.
Amooni Oza gaden ba duufuwan moogetis; iya bessan iya na7ay Iyosyaasi kawotis.
